intro: We don't publish a flat-rate price list, because electrical work isn't one-size-fits-all — the number depends on what's actually going on behind the wall or in the panel. What we can tell you is exactly what goes into a quote, so you know what to expect before we start.

cost_table.heading: What Actually Drives The Price
cost_table.lede: These are the things we look at before we put a number on a job.
rows: Scope of the issue, accessibility of the wiring or panel, and whether parts need to be sourced
Panel size and age, amount of wiring involved, and any code-compliance work needed
Size of the space, equipment being powered, and whether work has to be scheduled around business hours
Number of runs, cable length required, and the type of system being installed
Time of day and how quickly the issue needs to be addressed

notes: Call 570-472-3300 for a free estimate. We'll tell you what the job needs before any work begins.
